identificationModule.briefTitle: Neoadjuvant Immunotherapy Combined With Chemotherapy in Patients With Locally Advanced ESCC
identificationModule.officialTitle: Prediction for pCR After Neoadjuvant Immunotherapy Combined With Chemotherapy Using Single-Cell RNA Sequencing in Patients With Locally Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (ESCC) : A Single-Arm Phase II Clinical Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Prediction for pCR After Neoadjuvant Immunotherapy Combined With Chemotherapy Using Single-Cell RNA Sequencing in Patients With Locally Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma

interventions.name: Tislelizumab
interventions.description: Tislelizumab will be administered on day 1 of each cycle at 200mg once every 21 days.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel-albumin
interventions.description: Paclitaxel-albumin will be administered on day 1 of each cycle at 260mg/m2 once every 21 days.

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: carboplatin will be administered on day 1 of each cycle at AUC=5 once every 21 days.

primaryOutcomes.description: Total tumor regression rate under pathologyPrimary tumor or lymph node surgery specimen pathological examination without residual tumor cell

secondaryOutcomes.description: Total/moderate tumor regression rate under pathologyPrimary tumor or lymph node surgery specimen pathological examination without residual tumor cell
Objective Response Rate Determine the tumor shrinkage rate, tumor boundary and the adhesion of tumor
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of Cycle 3 (each cycle is 21 days)
